features: DATABASE CHANGES: EIGHT MIGRATIONS AND TWO SETTINGS MIGRATIONS, TWO OF THEM CHANGE THE DATA YOU ALREADY HAVE — The update runs eight new migrations and two settings migrations by itself. Three new tables: the program's errors (one row per error and one for each time it happened) and the readings of the communications (who opened them and who confirmed having read them). New columns on existing tables: on the millesimal tables the «of a group» mark, on the communications the request for confirmation of reading, on the ownership transfers the link between transfers recorded together; they start empty and change nothing of what is there. Two migrations do change the data you already have, once only. The first concerns the «F24 Ritenuta» reminders: until the previous beta every payment with a withholding wrote one, dated the 16th of the following month; the update closes those still open and writes in their place one reminder for each open F24 form and one «Prepara le deleghe F24» (prepare the F24 forms) for the withholdings that are in no form, with the date that results from adding them up. It only touches condominiums that have such reminders still open: those you closed yourself are left alone, and if a condominium gives an error its reminders stay as they were and the update goes on. The second gives a double-entry account to the expense items that an import had written without one: «Costi per Servizi» (service costs), or «Compensi Professionisti» (professional fees) for an item of type professional, as saving by hand would do; items that already have the account and income items are not touched, and where the condominium lacks the account its items stay as they are. The new settings, with their default value: recording when communications are opened (off) and «I condòmini possono avvisare lo studio dalla pagina d'errore» (condominium owners can alert the studio from the error page) (on). The notification preference «Errore avvisato» (error reported) is also created, off. No new permissions. The server requirements do not change. After the update reload the pages that are already open.

CHANGED: TO WHOM THE UNIT'S BROUGHT-FORWARD BALANCE GOES — The opening balance assigned to the unit, not to a person, goes to whoever was the owner on the first day of the financial year the balance refers to, not to whoever is the owner when you generate the plan. If Ugo sells to Elsa on 01/04/2026 and the brought-forward amount is € 180.00 at 01/01/2026, it goes to Ugo: no longer € 90.00 each. In the new plan, where a transfer touches the balance, the «Riparto saldi iniziali» (split of opening balances) window shows the badge «Tocca un passaggio» (touches a transfer) and the group «A chi va» (who it goes to): the rule already chosen and the reason why, the other people involved and «Divido a mano» (I split it by hand). The choice stays written in the plan and a recalculation keeps it. The buyer is in any case jointly liable with the seller (art. 63 of the implementing provisions of the Civil Code). With a succession and «l'arretrato agli eredi» (the arrears to the heirs) the brought-forward amount goes to the heirs in proportion to their shares; with «a nome del defunto» (in the name of the deceased) it stays with the deceased only if the death falls on or after the start of the year before the one of the balance, otherwise it goes to the heirs, who are the owners on the first day. In the window you can always choose someone else. Plans already generated do not change.

CHANGED: THE «ALREADY PAID» AND INSTALMENT PLANS — The «already paid» declared for all years is subtracted only once from the management: the print preview of the plan, the rows of the other plans without an amount, and a chapter that is in one plan while one of its items is in another all count it too; before, the program could subtract it twice. A plan of the management made with an old version of the program, with the row of items empty, writes itself the items it asks for at the next recalculation, with the same figures; as long as there is one like that, a new plan of the same management stops and tells you to recalculate the previous one. «Sincronizza» (synchronise) of a chapter no longer charges as an expense the income of a sub-account born after the plan. In the plan from invoices the amount of each invoice without credit notes is more than zero and at most what is left to put in instalments: zero no longer means «all» and the same invoice cannot be asked for twice. The «already paid» without the account «Fondo Passate Gestioni» (past managements fund) stops with an error instead of saying it was saved without writing to the cash account, and the advance already spent has a single instruction.

CHANGED: THE F24 FORMS AND THE WITHHOLDING REMINDER — Three rules for paying withholdings are corrected; one made you pay late. (1) For the 20 % the threshold is «does not exceed 100 euro», for contracts «reaches 500 euro»: exactly € 100.00 of withholding at 20 % is postponed. (2) The threshold is looked at on the month's total, not on each payment: with € 120 of withholding from a professional and then € 30 in the same month, the € 30 no longer end up seven months later. (3) Deadlines from 1 to 20 August are valid until 20 August, in the tax calendar and in the form's «Scaduta da…» (expired for…). Forms already confirmed do not change: «Aggiorna scadenze» (update deadlines) only redoes drafts. The «F24 Ritenuta» reminder is now one per form («F24 da versare», with «Apri la delega») and, while a withholding is in no form, a single one per condominium, «Prepara le deleghe F24», with the date that results from adding them up, the same the form will have. They update themselves with every new, changed or reversed payment and close on payment; if the payment is reversed or the form cancelled, the withholdings go back to having no form and «Prepara le deleghe F24» comes back. In the page of the form there is «Conferma la delega» (confirm the form) while it is a draft, and «Riporta in bozza» (back to draft) once it is confirmed. In the deadlines list «Scadute» (overdue) no longer counts the form that expires today; the account of the payment must be a bank of that condominium; deleting drafts no longer stops at the first draft without rows. If a form has already been paid and the payment is reversed and redone, the new form is born with the same withholding: the message and the page say that it has already been paid and not to pay it again.

CHANGED: HEIRS AND THE DECEASED — Cancelling a succession also stops after an heir's payment on the inherited debt, and says what to reverse first. An heir's payment on the inherited debt shows in the receipt detail as «Sul debito ereditato» (on the inherited debt), uses their credit if they have one, is no longer saved as «out of order, not declared» and no longer ends up in the summary note of the annual accounts as a payment without a reason. The heir's receipt states their share («la parte di Cecilia Angeli (50 %) della rata di € 65,58 di Massimo Bagnara», Cecilia Angeli's (50 %) share of the € 65.58 instalment of Massimo Bagnara), with share, already paid and balance of their part only. After a transfer on a unit the split of the plans is rebuilt correctly for the whole plan, also with units in co-ownership, and the check «Le spese personali tornano con le anticipazioni» (personal expenses match the advances) no longer changes result because of a transfer on another unit. A person who died before the deceased cannot be named as heir, and an heir who sells the inherited share and then dies stops with a sentence saying where their succession is, instead of leaving days and items without a name. The history of a cancelled succession tells the record of the transfer and not today's balances; the row linked to a transfer no longer disappears from the statement; the proposal of the deceased's interest with a repayment agreement no longer states a choice you did not make; with «si fermano al decesso» (they stop at death) the sentence says that after death nobody counts interest on that debt.

CHANGED: PAYMENTS TO SUPPLIERS AND LAST YEAR'S DEBT — The descriptive bank transfer of an invoice with a withholding stops and tells you to remove the withholding from the invoice first (reason «Bonifico parlante»): before, the notice promised the full amount, the net came out and the withholding stayed at «Debiti v/Erario» with no F24. The payment list no longer counts the offset against the credit note twice. «Usa fondo riserva» (use reserve fund) on last year's debt prepares the cover from the fund, with the transfer entry to confirm, as for an expense outside the budget, and a new instalment plan does not ask the owners for it. In the brought-forward debt the origin «Intervento d'urgenza» (urgent intervention) is no longer chosen by itself, so one does not become «da ratificare» (to be ratified) with the proposal of ratification for the meeting without you wanting it. «Imponibile (senza IVA)» (taxable amount, VAT excluded) says what it is, with the document total below. A collection that adds up to more than its own share no longer gives a 500 error: it shows the band «Incasso non registrato» (collection not recorded). When editing a payment the registered IBAN is visible, and one that is too long is refused. The ledger of «Entrate e proventi» (income) no longer shows a normal balance in red. Deleting a cash account whose opening is already in the journal, the program also reverses the opening («Elimina e storna», delete and reverse), and both entries stay visible.

CHANGED: THE CASH ACCOUNT OPENED AFTER THE FIRST YEAR — In the cash account form there is «Saldo al» (balance at): by default the first day of the open financial year, which you can change, never inside a closed year. The opening of a cash account created after the first year is written in the open year, at that date, and no longer in the first year at the date it started. Openings already written in the first year do not move by themselves (it would also move the cash accounts brought in by an import, which are right): a read-only command lists them.

CHANGED: THE EXPENSE SPLIT AND THE PRINTS GIVEN TO OWNERS — The expense split has one row per person inside each unit: with a rented unit the owner and the tenant appear, each with their figure, and the unit total, not the name of just one with the sum of both. The same in the plan's schedule by unit. It no longer writes «Piano Piano terra», and the messages of the empty list no longer ask for «piano approvato» and «rate emesse»: the prints also work with the plan in draft. In the statement of accessory charges the row «da ricevere da…» no longer has the minus sign, with an income the sentence has the right direction, and the credit is written «€ 27,52 a suo credito».

CHANGED: IMPORTING FROM ANOTHER SYSTEM — Confirming no longer leaves imports half done without saying so. If the list of units is missing, or the split and the tables do not match by some difference, the confirm button stays off with the reason and next to it there is «Importa senza i saldi» (import without the balances), with the difference in figures and the list of what does not come in; the result says you write the balances yourself, from the «Saldi iniziali» page. A second confirmation no longer brings a completed import back to «partial», and someone with only «Importa dati» no longer writes into a condominium that already exists: «Modifica condomini» is needed too. An error inside an import level no longer arrives as «Server Error» with the batch «in progress» forever: it has its code and «Riprendi» (resume). A CSV file with a semicolon, as an Italian spreadsheet writes it, is read. Co-owners without a share in the file get equal parts and not 100 each, and the unit's page lets you correct them. Imported expense items have their double-entry account. After an import that leaves two open financial years the program chooses the most recent, and the preview says so before confirming; the issue of instalments writes in the plan's year, and if it is closed it stops and says so. «Unisci» (merge) on a person who already exists asks for the permission on the address book; the permission «Importa dati» says that cancelling an import also needs «Elimina condomini».

CHANGED: THE ERROR PAGE — To anyone who is not the administrator the 500 page no longer prints the exception message, which with a database fault could give address, port and name of the database: it shows «Errore interno» (internal error) with a six-character code to look up in the error log. Only whoever has «Gestisci impostazioni generali» sees the technical detail, never in the public demo; in the public demo not even that is shown, and «Avvisa lo studio» is not there. Before, the pages did not know they were in the public demo: now they do. The page has a new look, with the code and «Copia», and after a save it says «Controlla se l'operazione è stata salvata prima di rifarla» (check whether the operation was saved before doing it again) instead of «Riprova».

CHANGED: THE INSTALLATION PROGRAM — On a database that already has tables the installation program stops with a clear message, already in the database connection test, instead of deleting them and starting again.

CHANGED: THE LICENCE NOTICE — At the bottom of the pages of the private area the footer is a single line: «© Vincenzo Vecchio — KondoManager», the version, «Licenza GNU AGPL-3.0», «Note legali» (legal notices) and «Codice sorgente» (source code), with the icons on the right. «Note legali» opens a small window with the four things the licence asks for: the copyright, that the program comes without any warranty, that it can be redistributed under that licence and how to read it. Whoever hosts the program can add the link to their terms of service with the variable TERMINI_DEL_SERVIZIO_URL, empty by default. The links open in a new tab.

CHANGED: THE DAY AND TIME IN ROME — The registration date and the year of the protocol number of a collection, and the «of the month» counts in the pages of payments and collections, are read with the day and time of your time zone, no longer in universal time: a collection recorded at 00:30 on 1 January no longer takes the previous year's protocol.

CHANGED: TEXTS THAT PROMISED WHAT WAS NOT THERE — «Tracciamento invii» (tracking of sendings) in the communications list said that reading is monitored: now reading is really recorded (see the confirmation of reading). «App» and «Push» are no longer among the channels. «Pubblica nascoste» (publish hidden) and «Rate emesse e notificate» (instalments issued and notified) say what they do: they make the instalments visible in the owners' portal, without sending notices. The portal no longer sends the owner the names of buildings in which they have no unit: communications, documents and events carry only theirs.

NEW: CONFIRMATION OF READING OF COMMUNICATIONS — Two distinct forms, neither with legal value: they are information for the studio. «Aperta» (opened): the program notes when the owner opens the communication in the portal, a single row per person and per communication with the first opening; it sits behind a general setting that is off by default, and turning it off does not delete the openings already recorded («Cancella le aperture» removes them, with confirmation in the row). «Presa visione» (acknowledged): in the communication you choose «Chiedi la presa visione» and the owner presses «Confermo di aver letto» (I confirm I have read it); it is recorded even with the general setting off. In the communication's page the «Letture» (readings) box says, for example, «Aperta da 2 su 5 · Presa visione di 1 su 5», who has read with day and time, who has no access to the portal and, with «Chi manca» (who is missing), who has not yet confirmed. In the list the two numbers appear in small type. The owner reads that the studio sees their opening. Whoever wrote the communication is not counted; links are not preloaded, so as not to count an opening that nobody made.

NEW: THE ERROR LOG AND THE REPORT — Every error of the program is also saved in the database, with the six-character code, the time, the page, the versions and the technical detail without passwords or personal data; with the database down only the file remains, and the page says so. The settings log page is called «Registri» (logs) and has the tabs «Email» and «Errori» (errors), with search by code; errors are kept for 90 days, grouped by type with the count. On every error there are «Copia il rapporto» (copy the report) and «Scarica il rapporto» (download the report), a text to pass to whoever supports you. On the error page whoever cannot see the detail (the owner, the supplier, the collaborator) has «Avvisa lo studio» (alert the studio) (the collaborator «Avvisa l'amministratore», alert the administrator): the alert reaches whoever has «Gestisci impostazioni generali» as an Action inbox task («Errore avvisato», with «Apri l'errore»), one per error, and, if you have turned on the preference «Errore avvisato», as an email too, only one per error: later alerts increase the task's count. In the general settings «I condòmini possono avvisare lo studio dalla pagina d'errore» turns off only the button: the owner sees the code and nothing else, the collaborator keeps theirs, and the log is always on.

NEW: SEVERAL SELLERS IN ONE TRANSFER — In a sale, also with reservation of usufruct, «Chi esce» (who leaves) accepts several owners: if two brothers leave together you no longer open a second sale. The program records one transfer for each person who leaves, with the same date and the same deed, all in the same operation: either all go in or none. «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) shows one part for each, with each one's adjustment figure and the total for the person coming in, calculated by recording the transfers one after the other as a trial, so it equals what is then written. Whoever comes in remains one person. «Annulla i passaggi» (cancel the transfers) cancels them all together, with a single reason; the history shows them in a single card («2 passaggi insieme»). Each one's adjustment can still be cancelled on its own. The sentences about who remains liable are in the plural when needed.

NEW: THE TABLE OF A GROUP AND THE MEETING OF ONLY THE OWNERS CONCERNED — In the page of a millesimal table the box «Per le assemblee» (for meetings) has the switch «È la tabella di un gruppo…» (it is the table of a group…) (garages, staircases, what concerns only some units): you turn it on, the program never deduces it from the zeros. An item voted with a group's table is counted on the group: heads, thousandths and quorum among the owners with a share greater than zero (art. 1123 para. 3 of the Civil Code), no longer «6 su 12» (6 of 12) for 6 in favour out of 7 garage owners. Under «Per chi» (for whom) the meeting can be of only the owners of the group («I condòmini della tabella «Box»»): the notice goes only to the owners, the room counts on them and their thousandths, the minutes say so and have their own minutes book, starting at no. 1. An item for the whole condominium (the annual accounts and budget of the whole condominium, appointing the administrator, the six-month waiver, the debt recovery rules) in a group's meeting stops with a sentence that states the risk, because the resolution can be annulled by whoever was not convened; with «Mettilo lo stesso» (put it anyway) you save it, and the choice stays in the change log with your name. The annual accounts of a management that concerns only the group always go through. In the transfer panel the heads in the room are counted as the room counts them.

NEW: THE SPREADSHEET TEMPLATE WITH ALL THE ADDRESS BOOK FIELDS — The people sheet of the manual template also has the second email, the PEC with the day it was communicated, the means of notification, the mobile, the birth, the document and the notes, all optional. Old templates without the new columns are imported as before; if the same person has different contacts on two rows, the preview says so.

NEW: «SALVA E ASSOCIA LE ANAGRAFICHE» — In the «Nuovo immobile» (new unit) page, next to «Salva Immobile», a second button saves the unit and takes you to the «Nuova associazione» (new association) of the unit just created, with the confirmation message; with «Salva Immobile» you go back to the list as before. Proposed and written by Federico D'Eredità: thank you.

NEW: THE COMMANDS TO FIND DATA ALREADY WRITTEN — The corrections of this beta apply from today, but they do not rewrite what is already in the database. Five terminal commands, read-only, list the cases to look at: «kondomanager:verifica-aperture-casse» (cash accounts with the opening in the first year and liquidity accounts with a balance and no cash account), «kondomanager:verifica-bonifici-parlanti» (payments with a descriptive transfer on invoices with a withholding, with the withholding left on the tax authority account), «kondomanager:verifica-pregresse» (brought-forward debts to be ratified with the overrun at € 0.00 and those with a cover from the fund of € 0.00), «kondomanager:verifica-gia-versato-in-cassa» (the already paid declared «still in cash» without the credit to the cash account) and «kondomanager:verifica-importazioni» (imported units with the shares of a role above 100); «kondomanager:verifica-titolarita» also flags the heir who died before the deceased. None changes anything. An heir's collection already saved «out of order» does not correct itself: reverse it and record it again.

FIXED: MEETINGS — In the person's page, «Voti» (votes), the two votes of the same item (for example the annual accounts and the split, voted separately) no longer merge into the last one: whoever voted against the annual accounts appears as against and has their thirty days to challenge, and whoever was absent from only one of the two votes no longer receives a proof with «i punti 1 e 1» (items 1 and 1). The person in co-ownership who came in together with the other, present without a vote, no longer receives the minutes as an absentee, and the sentence of the minutes that names them has the right verb and capital letter. The «Trenta giorni» (thirty days) card no longer contradicts the minutes page. The log no longer writes «Capitale sociale: vuoto → € 0,00» (share capital: empty → € 0.00) on a supplier that was not touched. The repayment agreement brought to a meeting no longer puts the owner's name in the notice of meeting: the item says «Autorizzazione di un accordo di rientro» (authorisation of a repayment agreement), with the figure and the instalments, and the name stays in the memo note, which remains with the studio. The time of the sitting is no longer cut off in the dates step; the browser notice no longer says «stasera» (tonight); the «Discorde» (dissenting) button is explained in the room guide; the receipt note no longer speaks of «Assolta». The text of the previous update said PECs go out 50 at a time: it is 20. The words of the meetings module no longer give a gender to a person («in comproprietà» instead of «contitolare»).

FIXED: FIGURES, DATES AND SMALL THINGS — The due date of an invoice is no longer rewritten when you open the edit page and no longer loses a day at the daylight-saving change. A double submission from the Wallet no longer writes two balances for the same person. In the users list the card «Da verificare» (to verify) updates after a user is verified. The «Scadute» counter of the F24 deadlines list and its filter count the day of the deadline in the same way. On a hosting that forbids changing the time limit the update, backup and restore no longer stop with an error, and from the command line they no longer lower an unlimited limit. The transfer sentences say «L'altra quota emessa su questa unità resta a…» (the other share issued on this unit stays with…) in the singular when it is only one.
